يستفهم (form X)
# يَسْتَفْهِمُ (yastafhimu) /jas.taf.hi.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
# يُسْتَفْهَمُ (yustafhamu) /jus.taf.ha.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
# يَسْتَفْهِمَ (yastafhima) /jas.taf.hi.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَفْهَم
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
